## What's changed

- Fix a brief full-width blur flash at the top of the screen when hiding the island with Background Blur enabled.
- Clip the combined native blur region to the window before sending it to the compositor, so a capsule that has moved above the window leaves no offscreen blur region.
- Add regression coverage for partial hiding, offscreen hiding, and restoring the island while keeping the top gesture strip free of blur.

## Validation

- Release build and all 15 CTest suites, including settings QML validation.
- Installer checks and 65 real Quickshell connectivity lifecycle checks covering blur, visibility, rounded corners, and detail panels.

## Installation

Update the existing Arch Linux / AUR package:

```sh
paru -S tide-island
```

For a source installation, download `tide-island-source.tar.xz` and `SHA256SUMS`, verify the checksum, extract the source, and run `./install.sh`.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/enhaoswen/Tide-island/compare/1.0.46...1.0.47
